description: Generate stories, blogs, emails, messages, and more with AI!
changelog:
Version 2.1.0:
    - Renamed to "AI Text Composer" (universal text generator)
    - NVDA+Shift+G: Generate title for any topic
    - NVDA+Shift+H: Generate full content (stories, blogs, emails, etc.)
    - Auto language detection (write "in Marathi" for Marathi output)
    - Your Name field in settings (used for email signatures)
    - Uses g4f (free AI) with provider rotation
    - Works on any platform (WhatsApp, Telegram, Notepad, etc.)
